label_definitions.label: quotation
label_definitions.definition: Wording copied directly from an identified source.

label_definitions.label: paraphrase
label_definitions.definition: A restatement attributed to an identified source.

label_definitions.label: observation
label_definitions.definition: A statement recorded as directly observed by a named observer.

decision_rules.handling: Classify the copied segment as quotation and assess its required metadata.
Classify the restated segment as paraphrase and assess its required metadata.
Classify the observed segment as observation and assess its required metadata.
Split at every provenance-form boundary; classify each atomic segment independently with its applicable allowed label and metadata status.

edge_case_handling.result: Keep quotation and mark the missing location.

edge_case_handling.edge_case: Copied wording followed by a direct observation
edge_case_handling.result: Split at the boundary and independently classify quotation and observation segments.
